system.description: A swarm of biting insects fills a 10' radius at a point within 15'. Sustained. On each of your turns, the swarm moves 10' at no cost toward the nearest warm creature, which may be you.

outcomes.triumph: As Success, but you choose where the swarm moves.
outcomes.success: A creature that starts its turn inside the swarm takes d6 damage, and is Blinded while inside.
outcomes.failure: The swarm forms but scatters at the end of your next turn.
outcomes.ruin: The swarm forms around you: you are Blinded until the end of your next turn. Roll on the Shadowblight table.
